headline: New Star Wars comic rivals Rogue One hallway scene
post:
Ten years after his unforgettable film appearance, the Sith apprentice has a brand-new moment that arguably rivals his famous cinematic corridor attack, according to Screen Rant. Written by Christopher Condon with art by Luke Ross, "Star Wars: Rogue One — Darth Vader #1" shows the Dark Lord operating as an unstoppable, brutal force of nature.

In this new Marvel Comics release celebrating the anniversary, Vader storms the oceanic planet Harreld's beachhead alone after Imperial speeders are destroyed. He deploys explosive droids, dismantles turrets with ease, and later confronts the local king. This issue also provides fresh context to the tension between Vader and Director Krennic following a failed negotiation over valuable kyber deposits needed for Project Stardust.

This sequence captures the same inescapable horror when average soldiers face the terrifying villain. Have you picked up this new issue yet?

#StarWars #DarthVader #MarvelComics
original_title: 10 Years Later, Darth Vader’s Rogue One Hallway Scene Officially Has A New Rival

headline: New X-Men: looking back at Beak
post:
Remembering Grant Morrison's legendary Marvel Comics run means revisiting characters like Barnell Bohusk, better known as Beak. According to Screen Rant, this unique hero debuted during a training exercise where Beast tried teaching him to fly. Unfortunately, his classmates laughed at him. Things only escalated when Cassandra Nova mind-controlled him to beat Hank into a coma. 🦅

Despite being considered an underdog who could not pass as human, Beak eventually built a family with Angel. Later on, the Exiles story arc "Earn Your Wings" showed him unhinged from time by the Timebroker. Though he was never a top-tier powerhouse, he ultimately retired from dangerous missions to live happily with his partner and kids.

Who is your favorite underrated mutant? 💙

#XMen #MarvelComics #Beak
original_title: 25 Years Ago, Marvel's Definitive Worst X-Men Ever Changed Mutant-Kind Forever
